pr_title: external: round robin to use multiple GCS clients
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #50413

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

I noticed that when we read ~1000 small files from GCS, the time of creating the connection is not negligible.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->


```
master:
=== RUN   TestSpeedReadManyFiles
    gcs_test.go:541: read 10 small files cost 184.228475ms
    gcs_test.go:541: read 100 small files cost 919.65221ms
    gcs_test.go:541: read 1000 small files cost 10.932206014s
    gcs_test.go:571: read 30 large files cost 4.31413421s
--- PASS: TestSpeedReadManyFiles (50.51s)

delete high throughput client:
=== RUN   TestSpeedReadManyFiles
    gcs_test.go:541: read 10 small files cost 162.914353ms
    gcs_test.go:541: read 100 small files cost 318.649369ms
    gcs_test.go:541: read 1000 small files cost 865.962228ms
    gcs_test.go:571: read 30 large files cost 15.210720205s
--- PASS: TestSpeedReadManyFiles (61.11s)

roundrobin:
=== RUN   TestSpeedReadManyFiles
    gcs_test.go:541: read 10 small files cost 169.609487ms
    gcs_test.go:541: read 100 small files cost 295.653485ms
    gcs_test.go:541: read 1000 small files cost 846.523461ms
    gcs_test.go:571: read 30 large files cost 4.289098557s
--- PASS: TestSpeedReadManyFiles (33.66s)
```

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
None
```

## Enhancement

as title. After we use separate connection for each read request in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/49340 , I see in the CPU profile lots of time is spent on TLS handshake when creating connection

review_comments: I'll leave it for future performance analysis.
